message.reasoning: User asks: "計算冰河時期是多少年前？" Means "Calculate how many years ago the ice age was?" They want the age of the ice age. Likely they refer to the last glacial maximum? Or the Pleistocene? The question ambiguous. We can interpret "冰河時期" as "Ice Age" which refers to the Pleistocene epoch, which lasted from about 2.58 million years ago to 11,700 years ago. The last glacial maximum peaked around 20,000 years ago. So maybe they want the time since the start of the ice age? That would be about 2.58 million years ago. Or maybe they want the time since the last ice age ended? That would be about 11,700 years ago. The phrase "計算冰河時期是多少年前？" could be interpreted as "How many years ago was the ice age?" Might be ambiguous. We can ask clarifying question. But we can also provide approximate answer: The Pleistocene started ~2.58 million years ago. The last glacial maximum peaked ~20,000 years ago. The end of the last ice age ~11,700 years ago. So answer accordingly. Use function? We can use geology_get_era with era_name "Pleistocene". Let's do that.
